2608.01775.title: Multi-Source Dynamic Graph Learning for Compound-Flood Forecasting in Managed Coastal Systems
2608.01775.paper_summary: Compound flooding in managed coastal systems is influenced by hydrological conditions and water-management activity observed across multiple monitoring stations. Current forecasting models can capture temporal dependencies with low average errors, but global error metrics may conceal poor reproduction of prolonged high-water plateaus that are relevant to flood early warning. Because hydrometeorological and operational signals are distributed across heterogeneous gages, single-site records do not fully represent high-water dynamics. Nevertheless, unconstrained fusion of cross-site signals can degrade the stability of local temporal forecasts. This work proposes an anchored forecasting framework that incorporates cross-site information through state- and lead-dependent bounded residual corrections. A multi-source regime representation constructed from hydrometeorological and operational observations adaptively calibrates inter-site relationships and correction scales, enabling targeted cross-site adjustment while preserving the local temporal forecast as a stable anchor. Beyond conventional global error statistics, we evaluate event-scale high-water characteristics through the temporal alignment of forecasted and observed high-water processes. Experiments demonstrate that selectively integrating multi-station dynamic conditions improves the prediction reliability of sustained high-water plateaus while maintaining high accuracy during routine hydrological conditions, supporting flood early warning and water-management decision support.
2608.01775.paper_summary_zh: 沿海管理系統中的複合洪水受到多個監測站觀察到的水文條件和水資源管理活動的影響。當前的預測模型能夠以低平均誤差捕捉時間依賴性，但全球誤差指標可能掩蓋了對於洪水早期預警相關的持續高水位平台的再現不佳。由於水文氣象和運營信號分佈在異質的測量儀器上，單一站點的記錄並不能充分代表高水位動態。儘管如此，無限制地融合跨站信號可能會降低當地時間預測的穩定性。這項工作提出了一個錨定預測框架，通過狀態和領先依賴的有界殘差修正來整合跨站信息。從水文氣象和運營觀測中構建的多源體系表示，自適應地校準站點間的關係和修正尺度，使得在保持當地時間預測作為穩定錨點的同時，能夠進行有針對性的跨站調整。超越傳統的全球誤差統計，我們通過預測和觀測的高水位過程的時間對齊來評估事件尺度的高水位特徵。實驗表明，選擇性地整合多站動態條件能提高持續高水位平台的預測可靠性，同時在常規水文條件下保持高準確性，支持洪水早期預警和水資源管理決策支持。
